entries.clue: Fourteen lines, with a turn near the end
A stanza, or the whole middle of a song
Posted, and kept far longer than it took to write
Left on a kitchen table
Tied round the bundle in the drawer
Hinged, and holding a photograph
Pressed flat between two pages
A small thing standing for a larger one
Steady, and not much given to speeches
The opposite of devotion's steadiness
Warmth kept at a polite distance
What a respected colleague is held in
Careful of a bruise
Rather more than merely like
Worth little, kept anyway
A vow before there are witnesses
A poem addressed to its subject
What a sonnet needs before paper
It makes a note hard to take back
Lines chosen for how they sound
A knot, or what a ribbon makes
Edging on a handkerchief
As an aim, or as a friend
How a letter opens
Said once, and meant for good
Sharp, or eager
A vow with witnesses
Wax, pressed with a ring
